name: Product Strategy Roadmap
tagline: A deep-forest strategic roadmap with oval portrait, serif statements, three horizons, milestone path, priority scores and measurable guardrails.

palette.description: Deep forest greens and warm cream with fine oval rules and muted mint accents.

typography.style: Literary serif strategy statements paired with distinctive geometric sans-serif annotations.

best_for: Product vision, now-next-later planning, strategic milestones, prioritization and decision-oriented leadership reviews.
avoid_for: Detailed engineering release notes, highly regulated finance tables or playful consumer launch announcements.
